scope: All 16 emitted originals of continuation batch 06 individually viewed at original detail. Complete refers to this review only, not the nine-batch measurement or any workflow gate.

Middle opens the enclosure into six circular sections. Generic face labels are readable but do not map Sleep/Measure/Transmit; CODE rim slightly crowds the Transition navigation label.
Ending reforms the cylinder; measured-current estimate versus observed 72-hour run and contact links remain readable.

Pointer after visibly selects Light and changes ground/text palette while preserving enclosure and full opening content.
Keyboard before has a visible focus outline on unselected Light while Dark remains selected.
Keyboard after retains focus on selected Light and shows the intended pale-ground/dark-text appearance.
Phone Light entry fits the full battery-claim question, projection caveat, disclaimer and links below the recognizable cylinder.
Phone opening rest has no visible main-text clipping or object collision; physical seams and rings remain visible at this scale.

controlFindings: Pointer and keyboard trials start at the actual Dark enclosure URL and reach Light, changing look, palette, URL and button pressed states on both viewports.
Keyboard focus is visible in both before images. Reports record five desktop and two phone Tab presses followed by Enter.
limits: Six visible sections open into a ring and reform the cylinder, but generic CODE/STATE/BOARD/ACCESS/SIGNAL/CLAIM labels do not map the caption's Sleep/Measure/Transmit teaching sequence.
Desktop middle geometry slightly crowds the Transition navigation label; main captions remain readable. Phone diagram labels are very small.

These provisional sketches and successful palette changes do not establish final material/diagram quality, motion quality, physical-phone or author acceptance, final-site readiness or an overall gate.
